title: Why Did Pop-Up Headlights Disappear?
description:
For thirty years, the coolest cars in the world had headlights that hid. The Lamborghini Countach, the Ferrari F forty, the Mazda M X five, the Corvette. Press a button, and the lights flipped up out of the bonnet like opening eyes. Then, in two thousand four, the last ones disappeared. Today, ten parts of car headlights, and the engineering story of why pop ups died.

Machine Reverse takes apart the machines you see every day and explains, part by part, why each one exists. This video covers 10 parts.

Chapters:
0:00 Intro
1:04 1. The pop-up headlights
2:09 2. The end of pop-ups
3:19 3. The sealed beam
4:29 4. The halogen bulb
5:38 5. The xenon lamp
6:49 6. The yellow headlights
7:57 7. The LED headlights
9:03 8. The matrix headlights
10:04 9. The headlight washers
11:09 10. The daytime running lights
12:14 The verdict

Sources:
- Pop-up (hidden) headlamps, US height rules, pedestrian safety, last cars in 2004: Wikipedia, "Hidden headlamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Hidden_headlamp
- US sealed beam requirement and 1983 change: Wikipedia, "Sealed beam" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sealed_beam and "Headlamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Headlamp
- FMVSS 108 headlamp mounting height: NHTSA, 49 CFR 571.108 https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-49/subtitle-B/chapter-V/part-571/subpart-B/section-571.108
- Halogen lamps: Wikipedia, "Halogen lamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Halogen_lamp
- Xenon HID, BMW 7 Series 1991: Wikipedia, "High-intensity discharge lamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/High-intensity_discharge_lamp
- French selective yellow headlights 1937-1993: Wikipedia, "Selective yellow" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Selective_yellow
- LED and matrix headlights (Audi): Wikipedia, "Headlamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Headlamp
- Headlamp cleaning requirement (UN ECE R48): Wikipedia, "Headlamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Headlamp
- Daytime running lamps, Sweden 1977, EU 2011: Wikipedia, "Daytime running lamp" https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Daytime_running_lamp
